_doc: Loomground Versum workspace config — reference workspace #1 (this machine). Phase-0 artifact: registers the 5 libraries, fences off infrastructure, names the KG roles, declares the one inbox. Machine paths are relative to `workspace`. Nothing here is engine code; this is user config.

kg._doc: The one KG = the Versum graph, self-contained in Loomground Sources. It knows its sources via its own libraries.json (root: Library, namespace dls). 'Digital Law Sources' was the OLD registry and is RETIRED (moved to _to_delete 2026-07-18) — no longer referenced.

_doc_exclude: Infrastructure — NEVER mounted or ingested. 'Loomground Sources' holds the real Graph/Versum. 'digest' is the news feed. Underscore/dot folders skipped.
